title: First sound
learned: Signal flow: source (VCO) → level (VCA) → mixer (console) → speakers
The waveform is the timbre: sine is pure, saw and square are rich in overtones
Keep levels safe: start quiet, then turn up

steps.why: A sound in a modular synth goes through a chain: something makes it, something sets its volume, a mixer collects everything and sends it out. You will build that chain now.
steps.do: The oscillator, amplifier, console and patchbay are in the rack, the patchbay is already wired to the speakers. Press Next.

steps.why: The oscillator is the source: it makes a steady tone.
steps.do: Drag a cable from SAW of the oscillator to IN 1 of the amplifier.
steps.after: The sawtooth now goes into the amplifier, which sets how loud it is (its LEVEL knob).

steps.why: Every sound of a song ends in its own channel of the console, where you balance them.
steps.do: Drag a cable from OUT 1 of the amplifier to IN 1 of the console.
steps.after: Channel 1 of the console gets the sound. The console mixes all its channels to MAIN L and R.

steps.why: MAIN L / R is the stereo mix; it goes to the speakers through the patchbay.
steps.do: Drag MAIN L of the console to jack 1 of the patchbay, and MAIN R to jack 2.
steps.after: You hear a buzzy sawtooth: your first patched sound. The chain is VCO → VCA → console → patchbay → Host Audio.

steps.why: Loud sounds come fast in a modular. Get used to setting the level on the amplifier.
steps.do: Press F1 and turn the LEVEL knob of channel 1 (CH 1) on the amplifier: drag it up or down, or turn the mouse wheel over it.
steps.after: The amplifier scales the voltage: half the level, half the swing. Start quiet when you try something new. A double-click puts a knob back to its default.

steps.why: Pitch and timbre are the first two things you shape.
steps.do: Turn the FREQ knob of the oscillator.
steps.after: Frequency is how many times the wave repeats per second: faster is higher.
steps.try: The oscillator has an output for each wave shape: SIN, TRI, SAW and SQR always give that one shape. MIX is the one you can change with the MORPH knob. Press F2 and move the cable from SAW to MIX: press the left mouse button on SAW, drag the cable end to MIX and let go. Then F1 and turn MORPH: sine → triangle → saw → square. Same pitch, different shape, different colour: the shape of the wave is the timbre.

steps.do: You built a complete voice path from source to speakers. Press Next to finish.
